problems.description: Regression from 3fb482b (patch 6). In `TsgoOverlay::apply_file_changes`, `if editor_open(&path) { continue; }` is the first statement in the loop. Because of it, a saved file that is open in the editor never has its imports followed and its `owned` set is never updated. A new cross-project `.svelte` import added in an open file therefore stays unresolved after the save, after reopening, and until something forces a full refresh (a directory event, an extension-less file, a config change). The same path applies to owned plain modules, such as zeno's admin/tests/*.ts importing `@admin/...svelte`. Renaming a component has the same effect: tsgo's edits land in open importer buffers.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s2.mjs. a/Plain.svelte is open, gains `import New from '../b/New.svelte'`, is written to disk, and a CHANGED event is sent. Final build (b925b7c): `1:2307 Cannot find module` after the save event and again after close and reopen. Only a later directory event clears it (`5:2322`). The same script on a 9e6c03e build (patch 5) and on a 5ed8ea3 build (baseline) gives `5:2322 Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'` right after the save event, so the import resolves there.
problems.fix: Skip only the re-projection and removal for open documents; keep the scan and the bookkeeping: `let open = editor_open(&path); if change == DELETED { if open { continue } … }`. For components: `let owned = self.owns_location(&path); if owned { self.owned.insert(path.clone()) }; let wanted = self.missing.remove(&path); if !(held||owned||wanted) { continue }; if !open && text differs { open_or_update }; scan.push((path, text))`. For modules: `else if self.owns_location(&path) { scan.push(..) }`, whether the file is open or not. Optionally, in `sync_tsgo_document`, also follow imports from the buffer text when the set of `.svelte` specifiers changes, so a new import resolves before saving, as upstream does.

problems.description: Regression from 560d231 (patch 1) and 3fb482b (patch 6). `follow_imports` skips any import target that is open in the editor (`|| editor_open(&target)`), and `refresh_except` skips discovered paths that are open even when they are not yet members. A new import of a component that is open at that moment is never copied into the importer's project. Closing the target does not help: `copies_of` only updates overlays that already hold the file.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s8.mjs. b/New.svelte is open; closed a/Plain.svelte gains the import on disk and a CHANGED event is sent. Final build: `1:2307 Cannot find module` while the target is open and also after it is closed. Baseline (5ed8ea3): `5:2322`, resolved. Unit test `review_refresh_never_adds_a_copy_of_an_editor_open_target`, added in the scratch clone at scratchpad/rsvelte-review: `refresh_except(|p| p == target)` gives `copy held=false`; the same call with the target closed gives `copy held=true`.
problems.fix: Do not drop a copy because its target is open. Replace the boolean `editor_open` with `buffer: impl Fn(&Path) -> Option<(String, i32)>`. In `follow_imports` and in `refresh_except` (for discovered paths not yet in `entries`), project a new copy from the buffer text and return it in `opened_or_changed`. The server then calls `open_shadow` for it instead of persisting it. Keep the open-document skip only for re-projecting entries that already exist.

problems.description: Regression from 3fb482b. When a DELETED event removes a component that a project holds as a copy, the path is not recorded in `missing`. When the file comes back (undo, `git stash pop`, a branch switch), the CREATED event finds `held = false`, `owns_location = false` and `wanted = false`, and drops it. Importers in other projects then report 'Cannot find module' even though the file exists, and keystrokes do not fix it.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s4.mjs. Delete b/Child.svelte (DELETED event), then restore it (CREATED event). Final build: Parent stays on `1:2307 Cannot find module '../b/Child.svelte'` after the restore and after another keystroke in Parent. 9e6c03e (patch 5) and 5ed8ea3 (baseline): `5:2322` again after the restore, so it resolves.
problems.fix: In the DELETED branch, before `self.owned.remove(&path); self.remove_source(&path)?`, add `if !self.owned.contains(&path) { self.missing.insert(path.clone()); }`. Inserting unconditionally also works, because `missing` is only read on creation.

problems.description: Introduced with lazy loading in 774d7fe (the baseline is worse: it never mirrored a buffer into a copy). When a project loads, it reads its copy of every component it imports from disk. `sync_tsgo_document` mirrors a buffer only into copies that were already loaded when that buffer last changed. A project loaded later therefore sees the disk version of an unsaved document until that document gets another keystroke. This affects every load: opening an importer after editing a child, and `rebuild_tsgo_overlays` after any tsconfig event, which re-syncs documents in HashMap order. Loads triggered from the references, willRenameFiles and request-forwarding paths also skip `activate_project` and `preprocess_loaded_project`.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s1.mjs. Open b/Child.svelte and change it to `count: string` without saving, then open a/Parent.svelte, which loads project a. Parent shows `[]`; only after one more keystroke in Child does it show `5:2322`. Script: scratchpad/s1b.mjs. Both documents open, Child unsaved, then a b/tsconfig.json CHANGED event. In 2 of 6 runs Parent lost the correct `5:2322` for more than 12 s, until the next keystroke in Child. In the other 4 runs it kept it: the outcome depends on `DocumentStore`'s HashMap order.
problems.fix: Route every `ensure_project_for` caller through one Server method. When `loaded` is true, that method should: for each open `svelte` document whose canonical path `overlays[owner].shadow_for_source(..)` holds, call `open_or_update(path, doc.text(), doc.version)` and `open_shadow(..)`; then call `activate_project(owner)` and `preprocess_loaded_project(owner)`. Use it from `sync_tsgo_document`, the references handler, `workspace/willRenameFiles`, and the 'unopened component' branch of request forwarding.

problems.description: Regression from 3fb482b. `owned` is only maintained by discovery and by events that are not skipped. A component the editor opens before its CREATED event arrives (opening a non-existent path and saving it, save-as) is therefore never `owns()` by its own project during the session. In `document_context_for_uri_in` the `max_by_key((owns, depth))` key then ties with a copy at the same depth (for example admin/src and admin/tests), and `max_by_key` returns the last maximum. A copy in a project loaded later answers requests for the new component with that project's compiler options.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s3.mjs. Projects b (strict) and a (non-strict); a/Uses imports ../b/Fresh.svelte. didOpen b/Fresh.svelte, then write it to disk and send CREATED, then open a/Uses, which loads a. Final build: Fresh changes from `7006 Parameter 'x' implicitly has an 'any' type` to `7044 … better type may be inferred` (a's non-strict program). b/Existing.svelte, which was on disk at load, keeps 7006. 9e6c03e and baseline keep 7006.
problems.fix: Update `owned` when an entry is installed: in `insert_state` (or `open_or_update`), `if self.owns_location(&source_path) { self.owned.insert(source_path.clone()) }`. Alternatively, derive `owns()` from `owns_location()` with a per-directory cache instead of event bookkeeping. The first fix above also covers the event path.

problems.description: Pre-existing, and not covered by the 'owner-preferring custom requests' change. `start_component_query` (server.rs, around line 3989) builds the component-attribute completion query from `runtime.overlays.iter().filter_map(..).next()`, which is the first overlay holding the document. When the project holding a copy loaded first, the probe and the answer come from the copy's program.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s9.mjs, completion at `<Child |` in b/Parent.svelte, where Child's props use a `paths` alias only b's config defines. Final build, only b loaded: offers `[alphaProp, betaProp]`. Final build, a (holding a copy of Parent) loaded first: offers `[]`. Baseline offers `[]` in both orders.
problems.fix: Choose the overlay with `runtime.overlay_for_source(&source_path)` (`serving_index`, owner first) and take the shadow and projection map from it.

problems.description: Regression from 774d7fe. `locate_project` returns None for a `.svelte` file under node_modules when the workspace root has its own tsconfig. `nearest_tsconfig` stops at node_modules, and the None branch only accepts a root overlay without a config. As a result `sync_tsgo_document` returns early, and library components opened from node_modules get no TypeScript diagnostics, hover or definition.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s7.mjs, root tsconfig.json plus node_modules/fakepkg/dist/Comp.svelte containing a type error. Final build: diagnostics `[]`, hover `null`. Baseline: `1:2322 Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'` and hover `const n: number`.
problems.fix: In `locate_project`'s None branch, fall back to the workspace folder's own overlay whatever its config: `overlays.iter().position(|o| o.workspace() == mirror_root && o.mirror_root() == mirror_root).map(ProjectLocation::Existing)`. This matches what `overlay_for_source` did before the patch.

problems.description: Regression from 3fb482b. `apply_file_changes` treats a deleted path as a directory only if it has no extension. When a client reports one DELETED event for a removed directory whose name contains a dot (for example `ui.v1/` or `date.utils/`), the event is treated as a file and ignored. The directory's components stay members, their bodies stay on disk, and tsgo keeps resolving the deleted components. VS Code's watcher reports a folder deletion as a single event for the folder.
problems.evidence: Unit test `review_deleting_a_dotted_directory_keeps_its_components` in the scratch clone: after `remove_dir_all(src/ui.v1)` and `apply_file_changes([(src/ui.v1, DELETED)])`, the result is `Some((0 changed, 0 closed))`, `still held: true`, `body still on disk: true`. The same deletion of `src/plain` returns None, which triggers the full refresh.
problems.fix: In `unplaceable`, also return true for a path that no longer exists and has members beneath it: `!path.exists() && self.entries.range(path.to_path_buf()..).next().is_some_and(|(k, _)| k != path && k.starts_with(path))`. Alternatively, remove every entry under the path directly.

problems.description: Performance cost of b5ce1d2. `activate_project` opens every JavaScript component as a tsgo buffer. That includes every component without `<script lang="ts">`, since `is_typescript_component` is false for markup-only components. In JavaScript-only projects, or projects with many components that have no script, this brings back per-component `didOpen` cost at first open. It is negligible in zeno, which has 2 such components.
problems.evidence: Script: scratchpad/s5.mjs, 400 chained components, all `lang="ts"` versus all JS. First diagnostics were 201 and 150 ms for TS versus 655 and 672 ms for JS (two runs each, load average 8–17). Total RSS was 77 MB versus 84–85 MB.
problems.fix: Open JS buffers only for JS components the open documents' programs can reach (the importer closure). Alternatively, write JS bodies with a JS extension so tsgo gets ScriptKind.JSX from disk: `.svelte.jsx`, plus `allowJs` in the overlay config and matching the import rewrite.

review.notes:
Verdict: ship with fixes. I found 9 problems, all reproduced on throwaway projects. I ran no session against zeno, so the lock was never needed, and I wrote nothing to zeno or to the vendor/rsvelte submodule.

**Regressions to fix before shipping.** Three of the major problems come from patch 6 (3fb482b) and one partly from patch 1 (560d231). Each scenario fails on the final build and passes on a 9e6c03e build (patch 5) and on a 5ed8ea3 build (baseline):
- A new cross-project import in a file open in the editor stays unresolved after saving (s2).
- A new import of a component that is itself open in the editor is never copied, even after it closes (s8).
- A deleted and restored copy never comes back (s4).

The fix for each is a few lines in `tsgo_overlay.rs`. These matter in zeno: admin/tests imports admin/src components both relatively and through `@admin/*`.

**Major, not a regression.** Patch 4's claim that editor buffers are mirrored into loaded copies is incomplete. A project loaded later keeps disk copies of unsaved documents: s1 shows this every time, and s1b shows it in 2 of 6 runs after a tsconfig change. The baseline was worse.

**Minor:**
- A new file can be answered by another project's copy instead of its owner (s3, from patch 6).
- Component prop completion still uses the first overlay holding the document, which can be a copy (s9, also in the baseline).
- `.svelte` files under node_modules lose all TypeScript features when the workspace root has a tsconfig (s7, from patch 4).
- Deleting a directory whose name contains a dot leaves its components behind (unit test, from patch 6).
- Opening JavaScript and markup-only components as buffers costs about 1.2 ms per component at first open (s5).

**Checked, no problem found:**
- tsgo crash and restart: buffers are replayed and bodies are on disk.
- tsrs accepts the same document version from activation and from an editor that starts at 0 (s6).
- Owner-versus-copy response mapping by shadow URI is correct.
- No panics in alias slicing or the specifier scan.
- Unbounded state: caches are bounded by the number of directories; projects are never unloaded, as the implementer noted.
- Patch 7's links follow the source's directory chain correctly.
- Solution-style tsconfigs (`files: []` plus `references`) are not handled, but that was already true before these patches.

**Test claims reproduced** in a shared clone at scratchpad/rsvelte-review: 453 unit tests plus my 2 review tests pass, 1 ignored; protocol 31/31; robustness 8/8; the other test binaries pass. `upstream_fixture_manifest` fails 5 of 7, as before the patches.

**Where things are.** The scratchpad is `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/`.
- Scenario scripts: `h.mjs` (LSP harness), `s1.mjs`, `s1b.mjs`, `s2.mjs`, `s3.mjs`, `s4.mjs`, `s5.mjs`, `s6.mjs`, `s7.mjs`, `s8.mjs`, `s9.mjs`, and `runall.sh <binary> <label>`.
- Template: `tpl/`, with a copy of svelte 5.57.0.
- Unpatched 5ed8ea3 language server binary: `rsvelte-ls-baseline`. Use it with the default TSGO_BIN, `~/.bun/bin/tsrs`.
- The two review unit tests are appended to `rsvelte-review/crates/rsvelte_language_server/src/tsgo_overlay.rs` (module `review_tests`). Run them with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<scratchpad>/target cargo test -p rsvelte_language_server --lib review_ -- --nocapture`.
- The final binary tested was `/Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/target/release/svelte-rs`.

problems.description: Regression (documented trade-off of patch 774d7fe, lazy project loading): workspace/symbol finds nothing in projects that have no opened document. The baseline loads all 12 projects at startup and finds them. In Zed, project-wide symbol search (cmd-T) over Svelte projects the user has not touched yet loses results. The same reach limit applies to references, rename and call hierarchy across unloaded projects, but no .svelte file in zeno references across projects, so steps 4e, 4f and 4j return identical results on both servers.
problems.evidence: tests/e2e.mjs step 4l.workspace-symbol-unopened, run after admin, packages/ui, tests/ and playground files were opened. Baseline: {"lengthState":["packages/plugin-seo/dist/length-indicator.d.ts","packages/plugin-seo/src/lib/length-indicator.ts","packages/plugin-seo/tests/seo.test.ts"],"decodeColor":["examples/documentation/custom-components/color/admin/src/value.ts"]}. Patched: {"lengthState":[],"decodeColor":[]}. Step 4k (a symbol in a loaded project, adminPathResource) is identical on both. Files: /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/results/e2e-baseline.json, /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/results/e2e-patched.json, /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/results/e2e-compare.txt.
problems.fix: Choose one of two options. (a) Add the opt-in load-all setting already listed under open issues. (b) Keep startup lazy, but when a workspace/symbol request arrives (or once the server is idle after the first project load), load the remaining deferred overlays before forwarding it. Lazily loaded projects are cheap now (admin/src takes 57 ms, the others under 60 ms). Until then, record the limit in docs/patches.md as a user-visible change from baseline.

e2e_differential.notes:
Built the end-to-end test at /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/e2e.mjs and ran it against both servers.

**What I ran**
- The script is plain Node and starts the server over stdio the way Zed does. Settings:
  - rootUri is the zeno root.
  - Same initializationOptions and capabilities as bench.mjs, plus pull diagnostics with workspace/diagnostic/refresh.
  - Edits are sent as incremental ranged didChange.
- Usage:
  - `node tests/e2e.mjs run patched|baseline` re-runs itself through bench/with-lock.sh.
  - `node tests/e2e.mjs both` runs baseline, then patched, then compares.
  - `node tests/e2e.mjs compare a.json b.json` compares two result files.
- Output:
  - /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/results/e2e-baseline.json and e2e-patched.json, each with a .stderr.log.
  - /Users/hyprsonic/Developer/adroyt/svelte-rs/tests/results/e2e-compare.txt.
- Nothing is written to zeno: every edit is an unsaved buffer. `git status --porcelain` of zeno was the same before and after every run (recorded in each JSON). No processes were left running and the lock was released.
- Every "opens cleanly" check first opens the file with a canary type error. It waits for that error at its exact range, which proves TypeScript is answering for the file, then removes it and records the real diagnostics.
- Expected clean projects were confirmed with official svelte-check 4.7.4: 0 errors for packages/ui, tests/contracts/admin_app and tests/types/svelte. bench/results/svelte-check-admin.txt already shows 0 for admin.

**Final run (load average about 8–11)**
- Patched (target/release/svelte-rs, contains patch b925b7c): 35/41 steps pass.
- Baseline (target-rsvelte/release/rsvelte-language-server with TSGO_BIN=tsrs): 24/41 pass.
- 16 steps differ: 15 are improvements in the patched server and 1 is a regression (problem 1).

**The seven requested scenarios**
1. **Open several files.** Opened 4 admin components (admin-layout, field-renderer, radio-group, json-tree-node) and packages/ui confirmation-dialog.
   - Patched: all 4 admin files have no errors.
   - Baseline: false TS2307 for bits-ui and @riducms/protocol, plus TS2769 in json-tree-node (fixed by patch 7).
   - confirmation-dialog: patched still shows one false error, TS2307 for '#lib/button/button.svelte'. This is shared, see below. Baseline also shows bits-ui TS2307 and TS7006.
2. **Injected errors.** Same on both, exact ranges: script error at 92:7-92:18 (TS2322) and template error at 202:15-202:20 (TS2345), no other errors.
3. **Cross-component props** (admin-layout → admin-navigation through the @admin alias). Same on both:
   - The wrong prop is an error at 120:22-120:32.
   - After a didChange on the child's Props, the parent's line-120 error disappears and 158:23-158:33 appears.
   - Closing the unsaved child brings the parent back to the on-disk child.
   - Neither server sends workspace/diagnostic/refresh after the child edit (0 on both). Zed's re-pull behaviour for the parent is not covered by this test.
4. **Hover, definition, references, completion.**
   - Hover on `runtime` shows `const runtime: AdminRuntime`; hover on `<AdminBreadcrumbs />` shows its Component type.
   - Definition of getAdminRuntime reaches admin-runtime.svelte.ts:656.
   - References of adminPathResource: 11 locations, matching grep across admin/src. getAdminRuntime: 122 locations in 61 files, 60 of them .svelte.
   - Completion in `runtime.i` and in a template `{runtime.}` returns 50 items.
   - Rename at a use site gives the same local-alias edit on both.
   - All of this is identical on both servers.
5. **packages/ui after admin.** The patched server resolves bits-ui (hover gives the alert-dialog module); the baseline returns null. An injected error is reported at 48:7-48:14 and clears, on both.
6. **Later-opened projects.** tests/contracts/admin_app, tests/types/svelte, playground/shadcn-rhea (solution-style tsconfig) and examples/blocks all pass on both. The patched server loads each project lazily (stderr logs each load).
   - Extra file packages/ui/dist (outside its tsconfig include): patched is clean, baseline reports TS2307 bits-ui.
7. **New unsaved file** (didOpen plus a watched-file create; not on disk because zeno must not be written).
   - Patched: the new file gets its errors at the right ranges.
   - Patched: a parent importing it type-checks its props.
   - Patched: closing it plus a delete event makes the parent's import TS2307.
   - Patched: a new file at the workspace root with no tsconfig still gets TS diagnostics.
   - Baseline: no diagnostics at all for the new file (empty after 60–180 s). The parent gets TS2307 instead. Closing it gives an empty list rather than TS2307. The root-level file gets nothing.

**Extra scenarios I added**
- **9a: watched-file event for an open, edited document.** The baseline drops the unsaved canary error (stale disk text). This confirms the bug that patch 560d231 fixes.
- **9b: Zed echoing the server's own cache writes.**
  - Patched: 660 events, buffers keep their errors, first pull answers in 199 ms.
  - Baseline: 57 events, about a 9 s rebuild before the first pull.
  - Both are behaviourally correct once settled.
- **9c: directory-level event.** The patched server keeps its buffers; the baseline goes back to disk text.
- **10: reopening a closed child.** Identical on both.

**Failures shared by both servers (bugs that predate the patches, not regressions, worth fixing)**
- **`#lib/*` imports from package.json don't resolve.** packages/ui uses `#lib/*` imports, and the shadow tree has no package.json, so TS2307 appears where svelte-check reports 0. Hover on buttonVariants is null. The patch-7 node_modules mirroring could also mirror (symlink) package.json files.
- **Go-to-definition into a component returns [].** This happens from a component tag, from its import binding and from the module specifier. tsrs does return locations in admin-navigation.svelte.tsx (line 159, generated default export, or the whole-file range), but the server's response mapper drops them. Upstream answers with the start of the .svelte file. In Zed this means go-to-definition on a component does nothing.
- **Typing `runtime.` right before </script> breaks the script.** It is a JS parse error: completion returns 0 items, and meanwhile every import in the file reports TS2307 (for example '@admin/app/not-found-route.svelte'). A dot followed by another statement does complete. Confirmed with standalone probes on both binaries.
- Both servers log "error handling method 'exit': EOF" on shutdown; it is harmless.

**Caveats**
- Timings are noisy (other agents were compiling). Behavioural checks wait up to 60–180 s, so slow runs do not cause failures.
- The patched server re-registers watched-file watchers on each project load (20 registrations against 11 on baseline). This is harmless in this test.

implementer_open_issues: tsrs (upstream oxc-project/tsrs) keeps ~360 B/file + ~70 B/import after every full program build (tsgo does not); our patches reduce full builds to project loads, import-set edits, file create/delete and config changes, but it should be reported upstream. Repro: bench/results/patches-evidence/tools/tsrs-leak-repro.mjs (MODE=import or open/close).

Component attribute completion opens a probe file (<shadow>.rsvelte-component-info.tsx) that matches the svelte/**/* include, costing two full tsgo program builds per completion (pre-existing, not addressed).

Workspace symbols / references / rename / call hierarchy now cover only loaded projects (projects of documents opened this session), matching upstream's on-demand services; an opt-in load-all setting was not implemented.
Copies no longer imported stay in a project until the next full refresh/rebuild (extra root file, not a wrong answer).

Not implemented: running the native lint concurrently with the tsgo diagnostic pull (~11 ms first open, a few ms per edit); spawning tsrs before overlay build is moot after lazy loading (initialize 3 ms).

bench/bench.mjs reports ps RSS, which macOS compression makes noisy (e.g. settled 166 vs 211 MB on identical runs); phys_footprint numbers came from bench/results/patches-evidence/tools/bench-fp.mjs. bench.mjs itself was not changed (outside my ownership).
docs/architecture.md (not owned by me) still describes shadows as in-memory and lists old measurements.
Pre-existing TS2345 in admin/src/core/forms/form-controller.svelte.ts (plain-module route; same with and without patches, also at workspace=admin).
Windows: node_modules mirroring uses symlink_dir, which may need privileges; failures are logged and fall back to the old behaviour. Untested on Windows.
